name: Flex Processor
description: A developer framework that attaches pluggable DataProcessor plugins to entities, fields, DataComponent value objects, or any other data structure and transforms them into structured arrays, typically to build decoupled/API response payloads.
provides_plugin_types: DataProcessor (annotation Drupal\flex_processor\Annotation\DataProcessor; interface DataProcessorInterface; discovered under src/Plugin; manager service plugin.manager.flex_processor)
project_description: Flex Processor is a developer-oriented framework for transforming Drupal data into structured PHP arrays through pluggable processor plugins. Code calls the plugin.manager.flex_processor service's process() method with any value; the manager inspects the value, derives a component type (type, bundle, variant), and dispatches to the matching DataProcessor plugin. Entities, field item lists, and DataComponent value objects are recognised out of the box, and an UnknownDataProcessorEvent lets subscribers map arbitrary objects to a plugin. Plugins extend one of the provided base classes (EntityDataProcessor, FieldDataProcessor, ComponentDataProcessor, or DataProcessorBase) and implement process(), where the developer decides exactly what to return. The module ships a set of built-in field processors (boolean, decimal, float, datetime, plain text, formatted text, list, link, file, image, entity reference) that produce ready-to-serialise values, and processors can recursively invoke the manager to walk nested data. The module has no routes, no permissions, no admin UI, and no configuration; it is infrastructure that other modules build on, commonly to assemble JSON API responses in decoupled projects.
